radiant.identity.organization_selection_: Your account belongs to several organizations. Choose which one to work with.
radiant.identity.no_organization: Your account does not belong to any organization on this server. Accept the invitation you received, or ask whoever administers your organization to invite you.
radiant.identity.no_radiant_role: Your account is a member of the organization but has no role in Danil Teams. Ask whoever administers it to assign you one.
radiant.identity.membership_inactive: Your access to the organization was removed. Ask whoever administers it to review it.
radiant.identity.incomplete: The server did not grant this account full access. Ask whoever administers your organization to review it.
radiant.error.invalid_server: That address is not a valid server. Use an HTTPS URL without path, user or parameters, such as https://danil.your-company.com.
radiant.error.http_not_allowed: The server needs HTTPS. HTTP is only accepted on localhost during development.
radiant.error.no_server: Choose a Danil Teams server first.
radiant.error.no_session: There is no session on this server, or it expired. Sign in again.
radiant.error.keychain: Danil could not use this computer's secure store to keep the session. Unlock the system keychain and try again.
radiant.error.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Check the address and your connection.
radiant.error.redirect: The server answered with a redirect, which was refused. Use the server's final address.
radiant.error.not_radiant: That address does not offer a compatible Danil Teams sign-in. Check the URL.
radiant.error.setup_required: This Danil Teams server has not finished its initial setup. Ask whoever administers it to complete it.
radiant.error.unavailable: The service could not handle the operation right now. Try again in a few minutes.
radiant.error.denied: Sign-in was not authorized. Try again.
radiant.error.expired: The code expired before it was confirmed. Sign in again.
radiant.error.rejected: The server rejected the operation. Check that your account has access.
radiant.error.workspace_unavailable: That workspace is not available to your account on this server.
radiant.error.organization_unavailable: Your account cannot use that organization on this server.
radiant.error.identity_changed: Renewing the session returned a different account. You were signed out; sign in again.
radiant.error.login_in_flight: A sign-in is in progress. Finish or cancel it first.
radiant.error.logout_remote: You were signed out on this computer, but the server did not confirm the revocation.
radiant.error.invalid_response: The server returned a response Danil cannot read. Check that it is an up-to-date Danil Teams server.
radiant.error.failed: The operation with Danil Teams could not be completed. Check the detail.
radiant.error.state: Could not save the Danil Teams connection in this workspace.
radiant.governance.invalid: The governance Danil Teams sent failed verification and nothing was installed. Try again; if it happens again, tell your organization's administrator.
radiant.governance.expired: The governance Danil Teams sent has already expired. Check this computer's clock and try again.
radiant.governance.denied: Danil Teams no longer grants your account the governance of this workspace.
radiant.governance.retry: The policy changed while it was being read. Try again in a few seconds.
radiant.governance.locked: Governed by Danil Teams (workspace {workspace}). This section is not edited in Danil.
radiant.governance.locked_short: Governed by Danil Teams. This section is not edited in Danil.
radiant.governance.install: Danil could not install Danil Teams's governance on this computer. What was installed stays as it was.
radiant.governance.not_governed: This workspace is not governed by Danil Teams.
radiant.governance.no_workspace: Choose a Danil Teams workspace first.
radiant.governance.unsafe_url: Danil Teams returned an address that is not HTTPS, so it was not opened.
radiant.governance.open_failed: The browser could not be opened.
radiant.governance.provider_not_allowed: Danil Teams's governance does not allow this provider in this workspace.
radiant.governance.model_not_allowed: Danil Teams's governance does not allow that provider or model in this workspace. Choose an allowed one.
radiant.governance.notice.denied: Danil Teams stopped granting this workspace: what it had installed was removed and the sections can be edited here again.
radiant.governance.tailscale.missing: Tailscale is not installed on this computer.
radiant.governance.tailscale.undeclared: The governance does not say which tailnet this server requires.
radiant.usage.another_session: That usage belongs to another person or organization: it is sent when their session returns.
radiant.usage.not_optional: This workspace's policy does not let you choose whether usage is reported.
